# NopalDB

> Embedded graph database in Rust with a Python API: nodes, edges, MVCC transactions, property and full-text indexes, HNSW vector search, BM25 + vector hybrid search fused with RRF, and NQL, a Cypher-inspired query language where semantic search lives in the WHERE clause. Built for GraphRAG.

Use the exact method names from the cheat sheet; `execute`, `upsert_node`, `create_embedding_index` do not exist.

## Python API

- [API cheat sheet](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/python/API_CHEATSHEET.md): one line per method, exact signatures, and the names that do not exist
- [Quick start](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/python/QUICKSTART.md)
- [API reference](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/python/API_REFERENCE.md)
- [Type stub](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/nopaldb/python/nopaldb/nopaldb.pyi): the authoritative signatures

## NQL

- [NQL reference (English)](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/en/NQL_REFERENCE.md): `find … from (pattern) where … limit n`; `similar_to` / `hybrid` as WHERE predicates; `score`, `rank`, `text_score`, `vector_score` columns
- [Referencia NQL (Español)](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/es/NQL_REFERENCIA.md)
- [NQL guide for Python](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/python/NQL_GUIDE.md)

## Retrieval

- [Hybrid search](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/HYBRID_SEARCH.md): RRF, filters, candidate sets, explain
- [GraphRAG](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/GRAPHRAG.md): search and expand in one query, neighborhood, communities
- [Embeddings](https://github.com/sharop/nopaldb/blob/main/docs/EMBEDDINGS.md)
